declaration.statement: Candidate evidence for one Buildpacks Lifecycle 0.16.5 to 0.17.7 plan constraint: target Lifecycle 0.17.7 declares Platform API support through 0.12 and rejects a requested API outside that declared supported set.

limitations: Tag bindings, source bytes, digests, exact spans, attribution and semantic scope require independent review.
The check compares explicit operator-selected Platform API values with declarations parsed from two caller-supplied Lifecycle config-shaped JSON files; it does not establish registry provenance.
The exact plan requests current API 0.11 and proposed API 0.13; 0.13 identity evidence is separately qualified from a later Lifecycle and does not change the target product version.
Using proposed API 0.12 is scoped PASS only when the platform implementation can use 0.12; negotiation, deprecation policy, build and runtime remain unverified.
Missing, malformed, inconsistent, ambiguous, out-of-domain, unsupported-current and other-pair inputs remain UNKNOWN or invalid.
This packet does not establish runtime behavior, whole-upgrade safety, signing, publication or support for other versions.

attribution.attribution: Bounded excerpts and immutable references to upstream Buildpacks Lifecycle source; attribution and licensing require independent review.
